notes.title: Welcome to Treeplanter!
notes.notes:
Hi there,

I’m Henry Driver, an artist, game developer and 6th generation Farmer 👋 and this is my new game Treeplanter.🌲

[previewyoutube=gXsxn1OWxM0;full][/previewyoutube]

If you’re reading this, it probably means you’re a nature lover, planet appreciator and cozy game player just like me!

It also means (hopefully) that you’ll be excited to hear that each copy of the game sold helps me plant trees, wildflowers, meadows and community orchards, through partnerships with schools, farms, communities and woodland charities meaning you’ll help restore real life nature too!! 

A little more on the game:
🌳Treeplanter is a relaxing forest sandbox
🌳You piece trees together like lego (nostalgia’s calling ☎️)
🌳Watch as creatures arrive and turn your grove into a living landscape!
🌳See your woodland change and grow as the seasons pass 
🌳As you play, learn about the world above and below ground
🌳Inspired by games like SUMMERHOUSE, Cloud Gardens and Tiny Glade 

This is a soothing interactive toybox for nature lovers who enjoy peaceful and slow-paced games. If that sounds like you, wishlist my game and keep your eyes peeled for more news in the coming months ☺️ 

Warmest tree-gards,
Henry 🌿
